reason: My guests ask the same three things, Wi-Fi, parking, where is the beach, and I already send a welcome message and have a printed sheet in each apartment. With several units, €35 each plus €150 setup each is real money out of what the renting brings me, for questions I can answer from my phone at lunch.
objection: In July and August I am drowning, yes, but the messages that eat my time are the late arrival, the broken air conditioner, the key problem, not the Wi-Fi password. A bot will just forward those to my WhatsApp anyway, so I still have to answer them myself.
would_change_my_mind: One price for all my apartments, around €15 to €20 a month total only in the season and no setup fee, so I can try it on one unit in July and see if my phone really goes quieter.
